decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain, close to the core shop offer and still publicly listed, so the firm has little reason to abandon it even though it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The ERP interface took substantial development effort and is central to the announced multichannel integration direction, so the firm will keep supporting it and treat weak signals as temporary.

As the surviving price comparison tracking plugin after C and E were consolidated, it carries the firm's earlier commitment in this niche, although its missing website presence makes withdrawal a real possibility.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A and fits the firm's analytics and measurable optimization focus, so keeping it remains easy to justify despite its low visibility.
